jobs_running_lease_check.name: jobs_running_lease_check
jobs_running_lease_check.value: "jobs"."status" <> 'running' or ("jobs"."lease_owner" is not null and "jobs"."lease_until" is not null)

sessions_waiting_for_check.name: sessions_waiting_for_check
sessions_waiting_for_check.value: ("sessions"."waiting_for" is null or "sessions"."waiting_for" in ('delegations', 'user')) and (("sessions"."status" = 'waiting') = ("sessions"."waiting_for" is not null))
